boundary: IEC supplies the continuous and intermittent blowdown valves (two in series); scope break at the outlet weld of the second valve; EPC blowdown piping, flash tanks and silencers.
contractor_side: IEC: continuous / intermittent blowdown valves outlet
isolation: IEC two valves in series (ASME I PG-58.3.6).
operating_conditions: Continuous blowdown up to 1 % of HP flow; intermittent 5 kg/s for 30 s.
protection: EPC blowdown piping designed for the drum design pressure up to the flash tank inlet.
